A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we introduce a novel test-time adaptation loss and a novel input transformation module that can be trained end-to-end without target domain labels.

we propose to use a confidence maximization loss with a diversity regularizer and a simple input transformation module to improve test-time robustness of pretrained neural networks to corruptions and other distribution shifts.

we propose a novel test-time adaptation loss for improving test performance of deep networks on data affected by distribution shifts, and that we show that it is possible to learn an input transformation module for partially undoing the effects of distribution shift without any labels.
The main takeaway from our work is that
test-time adaptation by entropy minimization can be made more stable and effective by replacing the entropy with a non-saturatating surrogate loss and adding a batch-wise entropy maximizer.
simple test-time adaptation methods that do not require any labeled data can significantly improve the robustness of pretrained networks to distribution shifts.
the combination of confidence maximization and input transformation can improve test-time adaptation to distribution shifts in a fully test-time adaptation regime.
